# FMEA Database Mining — Technical Knowledge Library

> Public, versioned, source-traceable mining maintenance knowledge. This is a discovery index, not an API or certified knowledge base. Canonical data and limits are in the linked files.

The glossary derives verbatim from the older author-controlled ontology and is pending technical review; the source listing is bibliographic, not proof of license or OEM serial applicability. The inventory is a pre-cycle snapshot and not an exhaustive semantic graph.

The atlas is a discovery aid, not an engineering endorsement. All subjects and bibliographic links require reading the canonical records; the hydraulic pilot is conceptual and not OEM validated by serial.

Cavitation, entrained air and abrasive wear are separate mechanisms. All three new articles are public, conceptual, pending independent review, and lack real field evidence, OEM serial effectivity and operational authority.

The 50-question report evaluates only a co-authored lexical router, not an LLM or independent engineering competence. No asset-specific OEM limits, real diagnosis or operating approvals.

## Functional architecture + frozen baseline challenge (v1.4.5)
- [Public functional systems portal](https://pedromaintenance.github.io/fmea-database-mining/arquitetura-funcional.html)
- [Functional systems graph JSON](https://pedromaintenance.github.io/fmea-database-mining/arquitetura-funcional.v1.json)
- [Post-baseline paraphrase challenge JSON report](https://pedromaintenance.github.io/fmea-database-mining/fundamentals-uncalibrated-challenge.v1.json)
- [Methodology and lineage](https://github.com/pedromaintenance/fmea-database-mining/blob/main/docs/CICLO_2026-11-07_ARQUITETURA_FUNCIONAL_DESAFIO_RETIDO.md)

Two systems are illustrations only (hydraulic implement circuit and rolling bearing arrangement). All edges are conditional. The 24-question challenge is post-baseline but editorially authored inside the same project, **not** independent blinded human review. No machine-specific diagnosis, OEM pressure test or operational authority.

## V1.4.6: function coverage and technical concept discovery
- [Public read-only technical query interface](https://pedromaintenance.github.io/fmea-database-mining/consulta-tecnica.html)

This is phrase-based document discovery, not a generative semantic AI. The 24 questions were already examined during development and do not measure independent generalization. Sources and machine effective instructions must be verified before any field decision.

## External human review protocol (v1.4.7)
- [Offline human query collection and blind review lab](https://pedromaintenance.github.io/fmea-database-mining/laboratorio-avaliacao.html)
- [Review batch JSON schema](https://pedromaintenance.github.io/fmea-database-mining/external-review-batch.v1.schema.json)
- [Public external review status — NO_EXTERNAL_SAMPLE](https://pedromaintenance.github.io/fmea-database-mining/external-review-status.v1.json)
- [Protocol, privacy and methodology](https://github.com/pedromaintenance/fmea-database-mining/blob/main/docs/AVALIACAO_INDEPENDENTE_PROTOCOLO.md)

No external reviewer or question data has been obtained. All independent benchmark rates are null. Synthetic unit tests cannot establish generalization or OEM validity. Do not transfer private field data into a public library.

## Role-separated dual human review (v1.4.8)
- [Anonymous offline question collector](https://pedromaintenance.github.io/fmea-database-mining/coleta-perguntas.html)
- [Blinded technical review R1/R2 — no search engine](https://pedromaintenance.github.io/fmea-database-mining/revisao-cega.html)
- [Offline human conflict adjudication](https://pedromaintenance.github.io/fmea-database-mining/adjudicacao-tecnica.html)
- [Public status: NO_REAL_REVIEW_DATA](https://pedromaintenance.github.io/fmea-database-mining/dual-review-status.v1.json)
- [Complete dual review protocol](https://github.com/pedromaintenance/fmea-database-mining/blob/main/docs/AVALIACAO_DUPLA_REVISAO.md)

No real question batches, external reviewers, human agreement scores or independent accuracy measurements exist in this version. Collection, labels, private adjudication and search evaluation remain separate. Distinct reviewers and independence are only self-attested. No operational authority.

## Field pilot readiness and local-data custody (v1.4.9)
- [Printable 20-question blank pilot kit](https://pedromaintenance.github.io/fmea-database-mining/piloto-oficina.html)
- [Eleven field-pilot readiness gates (machine-readable)](https://pedromaintenance.github.io/fmea-database-mining/field-pilot-readiness.v1.json)
- [Privacy/integrity audit (synthetic, NOT human)](https://pedromaintenance.github.io/fmea-database-mining/field-pilot-audit.v1.json)
- [Complete field operations and security procedure](https://github.com/pedromaintenance/fmea-database-mining/blob/main/docs/PILOTO_QUESTIONARIO_OFICINA.md)

No participant, reviewer or actual question has been collected. Real blinded assessments must use a new private reconciliation directory. Score CLI input and output containing human questions must stay under gitignored `private/`. These pages are not a live data collection service.

- [Offline 11-gate control dashboard](https://pedromaintenance.github.io/fmea-database-mining/controle-piloto.html)

- [Pilot governance methodology](https://github.com/pedromaintenance/fmea-database-mining/blob/main/docs/CICLO_2026-11-08_CONTROLE_EXECUCAO_PILOTO.md)

Manual flags are SELF ATTESTATIONS; they do not prove organizational approval or that participants/reviews exist. The tracking page has no incoming data service; real pilot data must remain privately held. No OEM authority or safety release.

## Frozen role-specific offline pilot packages (v1.4.11)
- [Role package downloads](https://pedromaintenance.github.io/fmea-database-mining/pacotes-piloto.html)
- [Frozen engine and record Git blob lock](https://pedromaintenance.github.io/fmea-database-mining/pilot-frozen-baseline.v1.json)
- [Public archive file SHA-256 release index](https://pedromaintenance.github.io/fmea-database-mining/pilot-frozen-release-index.v1.json)
- [Archive role isolation and reproducibility audit](https://pedromaintenance.github.io/fmea-database-mining/pilot-frozen-package-audit.v1.json)
- [Distribution methodology, safety and limitations](https://github.com/pedromaintenance/fmea-database-mining/blob/main/docs/CICLO_2026-11-08_PACOTES_PILOTO_CONGELADO.md)

Collector and reviewers must NOT receive the evaluator engine before gold labels are frozen. Source lock is against v1.4.10 Git blobs. All archives contain only public code and empty forms; no real human judgments or independent validation scores exist. Do not infer OEM operational approval from successful QA.

## Read before claiming technical facts
Public machine-family catalog specs are not OEM Test & Adjust limits. Synthetic reasoning exercises are not real failure events. A reference citation is not serial-specific effectiveness. Missing information is unknown, not zero, normal or safe. No automated SAP change, OEM approval or operational release.
